---
title: "پردرد شہادت ہے یہ محسنؑ کی شہادت"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"

Pur dard shahadat hai ye mohsin ki shahadat
Zehra pe musibat hai, ye mohsin ki shahadat!!

1
Darwaza jala dala hai hai, ghar bhi giraya haii;
Wa-allah qayamat hai, ye mohsin ki shahahadat!!

2
Jaltey huye darwaze ki hai ek musibat;
Us par se qayamat hai, ye mohsin ki shahadat!!

3
Eezaaein hayn dein jisne bhi khatoon e jenaan ko;
Us shakhs pe lanat hai, ye mohsin ki shahadat!!

4
Marqad me payambar ko bhi takleaf hai pahunchee;
Pur dard qayamat hai, ye mohsin ki shahadat!!

5
Hai zulm ki had aaj FIDA aal e nabi par;
Aafat hai, sad aafat hai, ye mohsin shahadat!!

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/pur-dard-shahadat-hai-ye-mohsin-ki-shahadat.md')
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '12345'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵')]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in blocks] == [2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3]
    assert ''.join(block.splitlines()[0].strip() for block in blocks[1:]) == numbers
print('Both editions have a two-verse opening and five numbered two-verse stanzas.')
PY"
